Title: Mina - Meeting Assistant: Your AI Teammate now responds and executes during your calls | Product Hunt
# Mina - Meeting Assistant. ## Your AI Teammate now responds and executes during your calls. Mina is an AI meeting assistant that actively participates in meetings, responds in real time, pulls context from your tools, and helps move work forward while the conversation is still happening. Unlike traditional meeting tools, Mina can speak during calls, use skills, generate outputs, and support sales calls, interviews, standups, customer conversations, and team workflows before, during, and after meetings. ### Mina - Your New AI Meeting Assistant. Mina is an AI meeting assistant platform designed to help teams before, during, and after meetings. Unlike traditional note-taking tools, Mina can actively participate in meetings, answer questions, use skills, and work across connected systems to help move work forward while conversations are still happening.
